arxiv-2210-07306.title: Feynman checkers: number-theoretic properties
arxiv-2210-07306.creator: F. Kuyanov, A. Slizkov
arxiv-2210-07306.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by F. Kuyanov, A. Slizkov. We study Feynman checkers, an elementary model of electron motion introduced by R. In this model, a checker moves on a checkerboard, and we count the turns. Feynman checkers are also known as a one-dimensional quantum walk. We prove some new number-theoretic results in this model, for example, sign alternation of the real and imaginary parts of the electron wave function in a specific area.

arxiv-2312-02319.title: Kernel Diffusion: An Alternate Approach to Blind Deconvolution
arxiv-2312-02319.creator: Yash Sanghvi, Yiheng Chi, Stanley H. Chan
arxiv-2312-02319.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yash Sanghvi, Yiheng Chi, Stanley H. Chan. Blind deconvolution problems are severely ill-posed because neither the underlying signal nor the forward operator are not known exactly. Conventionally, these problems are solved by alternating between estimation of the image and kernel while keeping the other fixed. In this paper, we show that this framework is flawed because of its tendency to get trapped in local minima and, instead, suggest the use of a kernel estimation strategy with a non-blind solver.

arxiv-2408-10259.title: Contrastive Learning on Medical Intents for Sequential Prescription Recommendation
arxiv-2408-10259.creator: Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam, Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Mei Liu, Zijun Yao
arxiv-2408-10259.description: Abstract . Recent advancements in sequential modeling applied to Electronic Health Records (EHR) have greatly influenced prescription recommender systems. While the recent literature on drug recommendation has shown promising performance, the study of discovering a diversity of coexisting temporal relationships at the level of medical codes over consecutive visits remains less explored.

arxiv-2507-00836.title: CO 2 infrared spectra on silicate dust grain analogs: Implications for JWST observations
arxiv-2507-00836.creator: Tushar Suhasaria, Vanessa Leuschner, Cornelia Jäger, Caroline Gieser, Thomas Henning
arxiv-2507-00836.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tushar Suhasaria, Vanessa Leuschner, Cornelia Jäger, Caroline Gieser, Thomas Henning. Carbon dioxide is one of the three most abundant species within the ice mantles around dust grains inside molecular clouds. Since a substantial amount of interstellar grains is made of siliceous materials, we have studied the infrared profile of CO 2 deposited on top of a bare and ice-coated amorphous silicate (MgFeSiO 4 ) film using reflection absorption infrared spectroscopy (RAIRS).

pmc-13188261.description: BackgroundFriedreich ataxia is a debilitating multisystem neurodegenerative disorder. pmc-13615792.title: Herbivore defense syndromes differ between native and invasive plant species
pmc-13615792.creator: Yu-Mei Sun, Feng He, Yi-Wen Zhao, Curtis C Daehler, Ragan M Callaway, Xiao Sun
pmc-13615792.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In their non-native ranges, invasive plant species may escape specialist herbivores and thus experience exclusive pressure from generalists. This is predicted to shape the defense strategies of successful non-native species, as proposed by the Shifting Defense Hypothesis. However, most research to date has quantified only limited sets of defense traits of non-native invasive plant species, and thus our understanding of their defense syndromes, which encompass suites of both physical and chemical traits, remains poorly understood.

uslaw-usc-t20-s7221.title: 20 U.S.C. § 7221 — Purpose
uslaw-usc-t20-s7221.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s7221.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 70 (Strengthening And Improvement Of Elementary And Secondary Schools); Subchapter IV (21St Century Schools); Part C (Expanding Opportunity Through Quality Charter Schools). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. It is the purpose of this part to— (1) improve the United States education system and education opportunities for all people in the United States by supporting innovation.

uslaw-usc-t42-s3104.title: 42 U.S.C. § 3104 — Advance acquisition of land for public purposes
uslaw-usc-t42-s3104.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t42-s3104.description: United States Code, Title 42 (The Public Health And Welfare); Chapter 37 (Community Facilities And Advance Land Acquisition). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority to make grants In order to encourage and assist the timely acquisition of land planned to be utilized in the future for public purposes, the Secretary is authorized to make grants to States and local public bodies.

uslaw-usc-t7-s136o.title: 7 U.S.C. § 136o — Imports and exports
uslaw-usc-t7-s136o.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s136o.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 6 (Insecticides And Environmental Pesticide Control); Subchapter II (Environmental Pesticide Control). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Pesticides and devices intended for export Notwithstanding any other provision of this subchapter, no pesticide or device or active ingredient used in producing a pesticide intended solely for export to any foreign country shall be deemed in violation.
